name: Nguyen Trong Nhan
body:
Title: A Certified 67-Element Squarefree-Sumset Witness at N = 3569 for Erdős Problem #1109 (f(3569) >= 67)

Extending past the previously reported exact jump point N_66 = 3065 (where f(3065) = 66), we exhibit an explicit 67-element subset A_{67} subseteq {1, 2, ..., 3569} (max element = 3569) such that every pairwise sum a + b (for all a <= b in A_{67}, including all 67 diagonal sums 2a) is strictly squarefree.

Two independent C++17 programs (direct trial division and a p^2-sieve) verified all C(67 + 1, 2) = 2,278 unordered sums, which are included in the linked Drive folder alongside the full PDF write-up and witness file. This establishes the constructive lower bound f(3569) >= 67 (equivalently A392165(67) <= 3569, narrowing 3067 <= N_67 <= 3569). Minimality is not claimed.
